svg.aria-label: Use: in a chat window you type /jano make this repository's README. Jano asks who will read it; the pointer clicks People who use it and the first dot fills. It asks whether to leave out unfinished parts; the pointer clicks Leave out and the second dot fills. A bar fills while it writes and draws, and a message says your README is ready.

text.tspan: Then it works on its own
